# Test fixtures

No third-party ROMs are stored in this repository.

The ReplayNES test ROM is **generated by our own code**: a hand-assembled 6502 NROM-128 program
(`engine/src/testrom/TestRom.cpp`, assembled by a tiny label-resolving emitter in that file).
Tests build it in memory (`rn::buildTestRom()`); a file can be written with

    replaynes-cli make-test-rom testrom.nes

What it does every NMI: reads both pads ($4016/$4017), steps a 16-bit Galois LFSR in zero page
and XORs the pad bits into it, writes an LFSR-derived tile into the nametable, changes palette
entries $3F00-$3F03 (video) and pulse/triangle/noise periods (audio). RESET does not clear RAM and
counts resets, so soft-reset timing changes later output deterministically. `*.nes` files are
git-ignored.
